instructions.name: close_empty_token_account
docs: Owner-only: close a zero-balance SPL Token / Token-2022 account owned by the Safe PDA.
Rent always goes to the owner.

instructions.name: close_safe
docs: Owner-only: close the Safe account and return all its lamports to the owner.
Token accounts cannot be enumerated on-chain; the client must close or empty them first.
Anything left behind stays recoverable: the PDA is derived from the owner, and
`initialize` accepts an existing USDC ATA, so re-initializing restores control.

instructions.name: create_safe_for
docs: Sponsored creation: any payer creates the Safe for `owner` without the owner's signature, so a
user arriving via CCTP needs no SOL. Only safe defaults are allowed (no agent, no CPI allowlist,
zero allocation); the owner configures the rest. `close_safe` returns the rent to the owner.

instructions.name: deposit_spl
docs: Owner deposits any SPL Token or Token-2022 mint into a vault-owned ATA.
This is the generic asset ingress path for assets such as cbBTC and xStocks.

instructions.name: execute_protocol_cpi
docs: Owner-only generic CPI gateway into a whitelisted protocol program. Pass remaining accounts as:
`[program_id_account, ...accounts matching Instruction.accounts order for that program]`.
The vault PDA may sign as authority via seeds `[b"vault", owner.key(), bump]`.

instructions.name: execute_swap_cpi
docs: Owner-only CPI into a whitelisted program. Pass remaining accounts as:
`[program_id_account, ...accounts matching Instruction.accounts order for that program]`.
The vault PDA may sign as authority via seeds `[b"vault", owner.key(), bump]`.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: One-time protocol config. Only the program's upgrade authority can create it, so nobody can
front-run the deploy and become admin.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: upgrade authority to be the signing admin.

instructions.name: init_executor_registry
docs: One global executor registry per program. Only the current config admin can initialize it.

instructions.name: kamino_deposit
docs: Owner or agent: move `amount` USDC from the Safe into the Kamino USDC kVault.
Funds can only travel between the Safe's own token accounts and that kVault, and a single
deposit may not exceed the owner's Kamino target share of the Safe's idle USDC.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owner or agent; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: kamino_withdraw
docs: Owner or agent: redeem `shares` from the Kamino USDC kVault back into the Safe.
`from_reserve = false` uses withdraw_from_available; `true` uses the full withdraw that may
pull liquidity from a lending reserve. USDC always lands in the Safe's own token account.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Owner or agent; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc_ata
docs: Treasury USDC account; owner and mint are checked in the handler when a fee is due.

instructions.name: set_agent
docs: The owner may rotate or revoke the agent. Pubkey::default() revokes it.
Agent execution remains disabled for generic CPI instructions in v2.

instructions.name: set_allocation
docs: Owner sets target allocation per route in basis points (sum <= 10_000, the rest stays idle USDC).
Future agent instructions must respect these targets.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Admin updates the treasury, the fee (capped) or hands admin over (e.g. to a Squads vault).

instructions.name: set_executor_registry
docs: Replacing the list can approve, revoke, or pause executors without a program upgrade.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Owner pulls USDC from the vault ATA. Authority on the vault token account is the vault PDA (`invoke_signed`).

instructions.name: withdraw_excess_lamports
docs: Owner-only: move Safe PDA lamports above its rent-exempt minimum to the owner.

instructions.name: withdraw_spl
docs: Owner pulls **any** SPL mint from a vault-owned token account into the owner's ATA for that mint.
The vault must already hold a token account for `mint` (e.g. created by a prior swap or `createAssociatedTokenAccount`).
For the mint used at `initialize`, `withdraw` is equivalent but uses ATA constraints; this instruction accepts any
vault token account whose authority is the vault PDA.

docs: Wallet whose USDC token account receives performance fees.

docs: Owner's target allocation in basis points, indexed by ROUTE_* constants.
